opportunities.title: Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered. Eligible costs include travel & subsistence, specialist investigation, hire of plant/site accommodation, materials, consumables, hire of specialist equipment.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains across archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture studies, history of collecting, and related fields.

opportunities.summary: Named research awards supporting projects in archaeology, art history and related fields; applicants are encouraged to submit innovative, interdisciplinary research.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grant (31 August round)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to eligible applicants as defined by the Society; specific eligibility details are provided in the grant scheme documentation.
